title: The Lavender Christmas Self Care Gift Basket
description: Lavender Christmas Self Care Gift Basket: BEDELITE zipper satin pillowcases, 2 pack, Velvet heatless curls set with satin bonnet, Puffy spa headband and wristband set, CoolMate cloud fuzzy socks.
intro: This is the gift basket I would want, so this is the one I am giving. Lavender satin pillowcases, a heatless curls set, a puffy spa headband and wristbands, cloud socks, giant claw clips and a lavender crystal candle. It feels like a spa day in a basket and nobody has to know it took me ten minutes.

paragraphs: BEDELITE lavender satin pillowcases (2 pack, zipper closure) and a purple velvet heatless curls set with a satin bonnet.

sections.heading: Spa night
